name: Kelly Russell
paragraphs: Helping others who come after me, staying sober, and being a better me today than I was yesterday are important to me.
I came to Hope House Guthrie after jail, heartbreak, and struggles with drugs, and through the drug court program.
NA and fellowship with like-minded people helped change my life. At Hope House, I found a new family when I had lost my old one.
I also serve as a House Leader at Hope House Guthrie, giving me a way to help others who come after me and give back to the community that has supported me.
I'm proud of working to complete drug court, staying sober without relapse, and helping whenever I'm needed.
I'm working toward a better life and showing my girls that their dad is back.
quote: Being a better me today than I was yesterday.
